mapper.insert: INSERT INTO webhook_log (id, external_event_id, event_type, status, error_message, received_at, processed_at) VALUES (COALESCE(#{id}::uuid, gen_random_uuid()), #{externalEventId}, #{eventType}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'RECEIVED'), #{errorMessage}, COALESCE(#{receivedAt}, now()), #{processedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM webhook_log WHERE external_event_id = #{externalEventId})
